days.description: Analyzing React 19 Core updates, compiler hooks, and hydration mechanics.
Under-the-hood analysis of rendering loops and reconciliation algorithm.
Architecting multi-level state containers and managing context updates efficiently.
State management without providers. Creating global stores with middleware.
Isolating logic, side effects, and state behaviors into clean custom hook layers.
How to avoid infinite render cycles, clean up listeners, and synchronize state.
Demystifying StartTransition, UseDeferredValue, and concurrent priorities.
Catching frontend crashes gracefully and implementing fallback recovery states.
Configuring typed generic components, custom event callbacks, and polymorphic elements.
Tailwind CSS v4 class organization, design token integrations, and css transitions.
Blending backdrop-filters, custom overlays, responsive dark backgrounds.
Creating simple entry stagger animations, transitions, and gesture controls.
Smooth blur, fade, and slide transitions between NextJS route template screens.
Animating dom nodes triggered by page scrolling. Timeline scrubbing.
Creating stagger lists and animating numeric targets in real time.
Rendering 3D viewport canvas nodes directly inside React component layouts.
Drawing custom buffer geometry and animating particles via frame rate hooks.
Capturing touch/drag events and mapping coordinates onto R3F canvas entities.
Identifying bottle-necks, unnecessary re-render triggers, and flamegraph details.
Build optimizations, environment variable injection, and bundler configurations.
RSC architecture, data fetching directly in components, and caching layers.
Securing data mutations, form states, and progressive enhancement layers.
Intercepting routing contexts to check cookie assertions and route access gates.
Using UseOptimistic hook to instantly render feedback patterns on mutations.
Deploying API scripts and managing low-latency edge computing scripts.
Rendering charts, radar graphs, gauges, and metrics summaries.
Writing unit assertions and mocking server/database triggers.
Simulating full browser user sessions and testing path routing inputs.
Maximizing Lighthouse rating targets, meta tag setups, and layout shift audits.
Auditing bundles and removing unused framework packages from compilation.
Performing interactive mock review sessions and generating feedback reports.
